checks.finding: The round-2 ambiguity finding regarding the characteristic-override namespace is fully resolved. REQ-004 explicitly defines the override characteristic namespace: the seven base characteristics remain unchanged, and the only permitted override-only machine names are 'credential_bearing' and 'release_write'. Any name other than these two is unknown and rejected. AC-030 and AC-031 explicitly state the negative and positive oracles (TEST-031a unknown name, TEST-031b out of scope, TEST-031c no-op baseline). No terms or actors remain ambiguous for downstream implementers.

No contradictions exist across requirements, acceptance criteria, constraints, or non-goals. The nine-component inventory matches across OQ-001, requirements, and acceptance tests. The characteristic-override schema extension is strictly additive and scoped to component and shared-path records. Rollback two-party and solo+cooldown branches are mutually exclusive based on registry cardinality, consistent with REQ-009 and AC-034.

Material negative paths and boundary cases are covered with observable acceptance tests: unowned paths (TEST-006b), unmanaged overlaps (TEST-005b), stale evidence (TEST-013), mid-cooldown registry changes (TEST-018a/b, TEST-034), zero friction (TEST-029), override rejections (TEST-031a-c), premature required-enforcement activation (TEST-033a-c), and reverse-coverage/digest verification (TEST-032).

All open questions (OQ-001 through OQ-006) are marked Resolved with dated citations and human rulings. Investigation findings are reconciled against the authoritative Issue #197 and #187 bodies. Remaining dependencies on A1-A8 surfaces are explicitly formulated as preflight verification checks (REQ-011, REQ-014, AC-020, AC-026).

All human approval and governance boundaries are testable: Context publication requires protected workflow sidecar and rejects unsigned/agent-approved sidecars (AC-002); Phase-2 promotion requires human evaluation and rejects unmet thresholds (AC-012, AC-013); rollback requires two-party approval or solo+24h cooldown with negative oracles for self-approved, duplicate, and unbound sidecars (AC-016-018, AC-034); WFI records cannot be agent-approved (AC-019).

The round-2 downstream readiness gaps are resolved: (1) REQ-004 enumerates the valid override characteristic namespace ('credential_bearing' and 'release_write'), allowing design reviewers and implementers to specify the schema enum and validator without external lookups; (2) the additive schema extension boundary is explicitly defined as an optional 'characteristic_overrides' list permitted only on component records and approved shared-path rules with exactly four required fields (scope, characteristic, value, rationale). The specification is complete and ready for implementation-policy review.
